channel.title: Hypewire
channel.description: What people are talking about in AI, entertainment, gaming and tech, refreshed daily.

item.title: Apple unveils the $299 HomeView hub, a new HomePod mini and Apple TV 4K
item.description: Apple refreshed its smart home lineup on October 13 with a 7-inch HomeView display, HomePod mini 2 and a faster Apple TV.

item.title: Google opens Gemini 4 Argon to paying developers and subscribers
item.description: Google's new flagship model reached the paid Gemini API and the Gemini app on October 13, with a 1 million-token budget.

item.title: Marvel's VisionQuest debuts on Disney+ with an 81% critics score
item.description: Paul Bettany returns as Vision in an eight-episode series that premieres on Disney+ on October 14.

item.title: OpenAI engineer charged after a hidden recorder is found in an executive meeting room
item.description: Prosecutors say an OpenAI engineer planted a recording device in a conference room at the company's San Francisco office.

item.title: GTA 6 on PC is reported for the first three months of 2027
item.description: GamesBeat says Rockstar plans a PC release a few months after the November 19 console launch.

item.title: Meta says hackers took code and data on about 1,500 people from its GitHub
item.description: Attackers used an employee's stolen login to reach some Meta code repositories, the company says.

item.title: GTA 6 leaker's meme coin crashes as it threatens to post the full game
item.description: Cyberleek promised escalating clips as its coin's value rose, then the coin lost half its value in a day.

item.title: Anthropic warns small AI models may soon copy themselves across smart devices
item.description: Anthropic's red team says small open models could be months from spreading across cheap internet-connected gadgets.

item.title: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse earns strong reviews ahead of its October 15 launch
item.description: Konami's new Castlevania sits at 86 on Metacritic, with scores from 6 to 10 out of 10.

item.title: Microsoft fixes a record 1,411 security flaws in one Patch Tuesday
item.description: October's update covers 1,411 flaws, including three zero-days, one already being exploited.

item.title: Nvidia's share of China's AI chip market falls to 34% as Huawei hits 28%
item.description: An IDC report says Nvidia's AI accelerator shipments to China fell 44% in the first half of 2026.

item.title: Below and Ben Affleck's Animals top Netflix's charts in their first weeks
item.description: Below drew 17.0 million views and Animals 23.8 million, while Ice Age films filled half the English film top 10.

item.title: Meta releases Muse Wonder, pitching it as a rival to ChatGPT and Claude
item.description: Meta's new Muse Wonder models are pitched against OpenAI and Anthropic on coding, reasoning and long agent tasks.

item.title: Epic reportedly orders an 'AI-first' workflow on its delayed Disney shooter
item.description: Bloomberg says developers were told to stop hand-writing code and artists to use AI, using Anthropic's Claude.

item.title: NTT Data is reported near a deal to build Anthropic's first Japan data center
item.description: Nikkei says the Osaka site could cost about $6.3 billion and draw up to 500 megawatts.

item.title: Jury finds Arm breached Qualcomm's license but awards just $2
item.description: A Delaware jury sided with Qualcomm in its second licensing fight with Arm and awarded nominal damages.

item.title: Battlefield 6 Season 5 launches with Las Vegas maps and joins Game Pass
item.description: The new season and the game's Game Pass debut both arrived on October 13, ten days before Modern Warfare 4.

item.title: Other Mommy opens at No. 1 with $27.5 million
item.description: The Jessica Chastain horror film took $27.5 million on a $19 million budget despite a D+ audience grade.

item.title: Hackers heat supermarket fridges across France, spoiling food
item.description: Intermarché, Carrefour, Super U and Monoprix stores were hit through outdated Danfoss refrigeration controllers.

item.title: Modern Warfare 4's campaign early access starts October 16
item.description: Digital pre-order buyers can play the campaign a week before the October 23 launch on PS5, Xbox, PC and Switch 2.

item.title: Microsoft unveils Maia 300, its own AI chip, to run Copilot from 2027
item.description: The third-generation inference chip is built on TSMC's N2P process and is meant to cut Microsoft's reliance on Nvidia.

item.title: Ledger confirms a hardware implant behind crypto thefts from resold wallets
item.description: Devices sold through one reseller, CryptoBilis, carried an implant tied to drained crypto wallets, Ledger says.

item.title: Fox releases the first trailer for its Baywatch reboot, premiering in January
item.description: Stephen Amell leads the new 12-episode Baywatch, with some original cast members returning as guests.

item.title: Linus Torvalds posts a Linux kernel branch written with help from Claude Code
item.description: The experimental patches rework how Linux reads cached files and are not yet merged into the kernel.

item.title: Practical Magic 2 arrives on digital after its box office run
item.description: The Sandra Bullock and Nicole Kidman sequel is now available to rent or buy on digital stores.

item.title: AI agent startup Decagon is reported in early buyout talks with ServiceNow
item.description: Business Insider says Decagon, last valued at $4.5 billion, has hired an investment bank to field interest.

item.title: Ahold Delhaize takes systems offline after a cyber incident
item.description: Albert Heijn warned of empty shelves as distribution centers stopped, and US chains' websites went down.

item.title: IMF raises its 2026 growth forecast and credits the AI investment boom
item.description: The IMF now sees 3.1% global growth this year and modeled the cost of a sudden pullback in AI spending.

item.title: Steam sets a new record with 43.5 million users online at once
item.description: SteamDB recorded the all-time peak on October 11, though only about a third of users were in a game.

item.title: Anthropic says new safeguards cut model copying by 90% or more
item.description: The company says changes made against distillation sharply reduced attempts to harvest Claude's outputs to train rivals.

item.title: Ivanti warns a Connect Secure zero-day is being exploited in attacks
item.description: Ivanti urged customers to patch a flaw in its Connect Secure remote access gateway that attackers are already using.

item.title: Taylor Swift becomes the first solo act with 100 weeks at No. 1
item.description: The Life of a Showgirl spent a 14th week atop the Billboard 200, leaving only the Beatles ahead of her on the all-time list.

item.title: Drone strikes shut a third Yandex data center in four days
item.description: Russian taxi, cloud and smart home services went down after the Vladimir site closed on October 11.

item.title: Nvidia opens its Vera Rubin rack designs, and Meta adopts its Spectrum-6 switches
item.description: At the OCP Global Summit, Nvidia contributed rack and tray designs so other firms can build compatible AI systems.

item.title: Marvel Tokon adds Jane Foster, Venom and Jubilee as Year 1 DLC
item.description: Three more fighters are coming to Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls after launch, alongside Phoenix Cyclops in November.

item.title: It Takes Two comes to Switch 2 on October 15 with cross-play
item.description: EA's co-op hit gets a free upgrade for Switch owners, with 1080p and 60fps when docked.

item.title: Chris Evans and Anya Taylor-Joy's Sacrifice comes to Netflix on October 16
item.description: The apocalyptic comedy-thriller leads a busy week of new streaming films.

item.title: The Social Reckoning opens to $5.5 million in fifth place
item.description: Aaron Sorkin's follow-up to The Social Network opened fifth, below a third of the original's 2010 debut.
